```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5, out.width = "100%")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(DT)
  library(plotly)
})

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 14))

hits <- read.delim(params$hits_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
summary_df <- read.delim(params$summary_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

threshold <- params$threshold

has_self <- any(hits$mode == "self") || any(summary_df$mode == "self")
has_against <- any(hits$mode == "against") || any(summary_df$mode == "against")

hits_self <- hits %>% filter(mode == "self")
hits_against <- hits %>% filter(mode == "against")
summary_self <- summary_df %>% filter(mode == "self")
summary_against <- summary_df %>% filter(mode == "against")

n_probes <- length(unique(summary_df$probe_id))

has_params <- params$params_file != "" && file.exists(params$params_file)
if (has_params) {
  params_df <- read.delim(params$params_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Scalability thresholds
n_genomes_against <- length(unique(hits_against$target_id))
```

## Analysis Summary

```{r summary_table, results='asis'}
info <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Homology threshold", "Total probes"),
  Value = c(paste0(threshold, "%"), n_probes),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (has_self) {
  n_self_flagged <- sum(summary_self$num_hits_above_threshold > 0)
  info <- rbind(info, data.frame(
    Parameter = c("Mode: self", "Probes with self-homology hits", "Self-mode hits"),
    Value = c("Yes", paste0(n_self_flagged, " / ", n_probes,
                            " (", round(100 * n_self_flagged / max(n_probes, 1), 1), "%)"),
              nrow(hits_self))
  ))
}

if (has_against) {
  n_against_flagged <- sum(summary_against$num_hits_above_threshold > 0)
  info <- rbind(info, data.frame(
    Parameter = c("Mode: against", "Probes with cross-reactive hits",
                  "Genomes with hits", "Against-mode hits"),
    Value = c("Yes",
              paste0(n_against_flagged, " / ", n_probes,
                     " (", round(100 * n_against_flagged / max(n_probes, 1), 1), "%)"),
              n_genomes_against,
              nrow(hits_against))
  ))
}

knitr::kable(info, col.names = c("Parameter", "Value"), align = "lr")
```

```{r params_fold, eval=has_params, results='asis'}
cat('<details><summary>Parameters</summary>\n\n')
```

```{r params_table, eval=has_params}
display_params <- params_df %>%
  select(parameter, value)
knitr::kable(display_params, col.names = c("Parameter", "Value"), align = "ll")
```

```{r params_command, eval=has_params, results='asis'}
cmd_parts <- c("baitbench xreact")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(params_df))) {
  flag <- params_df$flag[i]
  value <- params_df$value[i]
  if (value == "none" || value == "false") next
  if (value == "true") {
    cmd_parts <- c(cmd_parts, sprintf("  %s", flag))
  } else {
    cmd_parts <- c(cmd_parts, sprintf("  %s %s", flag, value))
  }
}
cat("```bash\n")
cat(paste(cmd_parts, collapse = " \\\n"), "\n")
cat("```\n")
```

```{r params_fold_end, eval=has_params, results='asis'}
cat('</details>\n\n')
```

```{r self_section, eval=has_self, results='asis'}
cat("\n## Self-Homology (Probe vs Probe)\n")
```

```{r self_heatmap, eval=has_self && n_probes < 1000,  out.width="100%"}
all_probe_ids <- sort(unique(summary_df$probe_id))
n <- length(all_probe_ids)

# Build NxN matrix (rows = target, cols = probe)
mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = n,
              dimnames = list(all_probe_ids, all_probe_ids))
hover_mat <- matrix("", nrow = n, ncol = n,
                    dimnames = list(all_probe_ids, all_probe_ids))

if (nrow(hits_self) > 0) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(hits_self))) {
    row <- hits_self[i, ]
    ri <- match(row$target_id, all_probe_ids)
    ci <- match(row$probe_id, all_probe_ids)
    if (!is.na(ri) && !is.na(ci)) {
      # Keep the highest homology if multiple alignments exist
      if (is.na(mat[ri, ci]) || row$homology_pct > mat[ri, ci]) {
        mat[ri, ci] <- row$homology_pct
        hover_mat[ri, ci] <- paste0(
          "Probe: ", row$probe_id, "<br>",
          "Target: ", row$target_id, "<br>",
          "Homology: ", round(row$homology_pct, 1), "%<br>",
          "Identity: ", round(row$identity_pct, 1), "%<br>",
          "Query coverage: ", round(row$query_coverage_pct, 1), "%"
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

show_labels <- n <= 20

# Color scale: steelblue (low) → firebrick (high), NA = white
plot_ly(
  z = mat,
  x = colnames(mat),
  y = rownames(mat),
  type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = list(c(0, "steelblue"), c(0.5, "orange"), c(1, "firebrick")),
#  colorscale = list(c(0.0, "#32CD32"), c(1, "#FF00FF")),
  #colorscale = list(c(0.0, "#00BFFF"), c(1, "#FF1493")),

  zmin = threshold,
  zmax = 100,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  text = hover_mat,
  showscale = TRUE,
  colorbar = list(title = "Homology %"),
  height = 800,
  width = 1000
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Self-Homology Matrix",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Probe",
      showticklabels = show_labels,
      tickangle = if (show_labels) -45 else 0,
      showgrid = FALSE

    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Target probe",
      showticklabels = show_labels,
      autorange = "reversed",
      showgrid = FALSE 
    ),
#    plot_bgcolor = "#EDE8D0",
    plot_bgcolor = "white",
    height = NULL,  # Auto scale to container size
    xgap = 0.5, ygap = 0.5
  )
```

```{r self_heatmap_skip, eval=has_self && n_probes >= 1000, results='asis'}
cat(paste0("\n*Heatmap omitted: ", n_probes,
           " probes exceeds the 1,000 probe limit for interactive display.*\n"))
```

```{r self_density_header, eval=has_self && nrow(hits_self) > 0, results='asis'}
cat("\n### Homology Distribution\n")
```

```{r self_density, eval=has_self && nrow(hits_self) > 0, fig.height=4}

ggplot(summary_self, aes(x = max_homology_pct)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue", adjust = 1/4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = threshold, y = Inf, label = paste0("Threshold: ", threshold, "%"),
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, color = "firebrick", size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "Homology (%)", y = "Density", title = "Maximum Homology for All Probes") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggplot(hits_self, aes(x = homology_pct)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue", adjust = 1/2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = threshold, y = Inf, label = paste0("Threshold: ", threshold, "%"),
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, color = "firebrick", size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(max(threshold - 10, 0), 100)) +
  labs(x = "Homology (%)", y = "Density", title = "Self-Homology Distribution for Hits Above Threshold") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)






```

```{r self_table_header, eval=has_self, results='asis'}
cat("\n### All Self-Homology Hits\n")
```

```{r self_table, eval=has_self}
display_self <- hits_self %>%
  select(probe_id, target_id, homology_pct, identity_pct,
         query_coverage_pct, matching_bases, probe_length) %>%
  arrange(desc(homology_pct))

datatable(
  display_self,
  colnames = c("Probe", "Target Probe", "Homology %", "Identity %",
               "Query Cov %", "Matching Bases", "Probe Length"),
  options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE,
                 order = list(list(2, "desc"))),
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = if (nrow(display_self) > 50) "top" else "none"
) %>%
  formatRound(c("homology_pct", "identity_pct", "query_coverage_pct"), 1)
```

```{r against_section, eval=has_against, results='asis'}
cat("\n## Cross-Reactivity (Probe vs Genome)\n")
```

```{r against_heatmap, eval=has_against && n_probes < 1000, fig.height=8}
# Only include probes that have at least one against-mode hit
probes_with_hits <- sort(unique(hits_against$probe_id))
genomes <- sort(unique(hits_against$target_id))
n_probes_hit <- length(probes_with_hits)
n_genomes_hit <- length(genomes)

if (n_probes_hit > 0 && n_genomes_hit > 0) {
  # Build genome (rows) x probe (cols) matrix
  mat_ag <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_genomes_hit, ncol = n_probes_hit,
                   dimnames = list(genomes, probes_with_hits))
  hover_ag <- matrix("", nrow = n_genomes_hit, ncol = n_probes_hit,
                     dimnames = list(genomes, probes_with_hits))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(hits_against))) {
    row <- hits_against[i, ]
    ri <- match(row$target_id, genomes)
    ci <- match(row$probe_id, probes_with_hits)
    if (!is.na(ri) && !is.na(ci)) {
      if (is.na(mat_ag[ri, ci]) || row$homology_pct > mat_ag[ri, ci]) {
        mat_ag[ri, ci] <- row$homology_pct
        hover_ag[ri, ci] <- paste0(
          "Probe: ", row$probe_id, "<br>",
          "Genome: ", row$target_id, "<br>",
          "Homology: ", round(row$homology_pct, 1), "%<br>",
          "Identity: ", round(row$identity_pct, 1), "%<br>",
          "Query coverage: ", round(row$query_coverage_pct, 1), "%"
        )
      }
    }
  }

  show_x <- n_probes_hit <= 20
  show_y <- n_genomes_hit <= 20

  # Dynamic height: at least 400px, scale with genome count
  plot_height <- max(400, n_genomes_hit * 20 + 150)

  plot_ly(
    z = mat_ag,
    x = colnames(mat_ag),
    y = rownames(mat_ag),
    type = "heatmap",
    colorscale = list(c(0, "steelblue"), c(0.5, "orange"), c(1, "firebrick")),
    zmin = threshold,
    zmax = 100,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    text = hover_ag,
    showscale = TRUE,
    colorbar = list(title = "Homology %"),
    height = plot_height
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = paste0("Cross-Reactivity Matrix (",
                     n_probes_hit, " probes x ", n_genomes_hit, " genomes)"),
      xaxis = list(
        title = "Probe",
        showticklabels = show_x,
        tickangle = if (show_x) -45 else 0,
        showgrid = FALSE
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        title = "Genome",
        showticklabels = show_y,
        autorange = "reversed",
        showgrid = FALSE
      ),
      plot_bgcolor = "white"
    )
}
```

```{r against_heatmap_skip, eval=has_against && n_probes >= 1000, results='asis'}
cat(paste0("\n*Heatmap omitted: ", n_probes,
           " probes exceeds the 1,000 probe limit for interactive display.*\n"))
```

```{r against_genome_bar_header, eval=has_against && nrow(hits_against) > 0, results='asis'}
cat("\n### Probes per Genome\n")
```

```{r against_genome_bar, eval=has_against && nrow(hits_against) > 0 && n_genomes_against <= 100, fig.height=max(4, n_genomes_against * 0.3 + 1)}
# Bar chart: individual genome bars (small/medium panels)
genome_counts <- hits_against %>%
  group_by(target_id) %>%
  summarise(n_probes = n_distinct(probe_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(n_probes) %>%
  mutate(target_id = factor(target_id, levels = target_id))

ggplot(genome_counts, aes(x = n_probes, y = target_id)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Number of cross-reactive probes", y = NULL,
       title = "Cross-Reactive Probes per Genome") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = if (n_genomes_against <= 20) 14 else 8)
```

```{r against_genome_bar_large, eval=has_against && nrow(hits_against) > 0 && n_genomes_against > 100, fig.height=5}
# Histogram: distribution of hit counts per genome (large panels)
genome_counts <- hits_against %>%
  group_by(target_id) %>%
  summarise(n_probes = n_distinct(probe_id), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(genome_counts, aes(x = n_probes)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8, color = "white", binwidth = max(1, ceiling(max(genome_counts$n_probes) / 30))) +
  labs(x = "Number of cross-reactive probes per genome", y = "Number of genomes",
       title = paste0("Distribution of Cross-Reactive Probes (",
                      n_genomes_against, " genomes)")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
